svg.data-power-current-max: 1 A at 100 VAC; 0.5 A at 240 VAC
svg.data-optics-sfp-plus: hardware guide, Uplink Ports: the two uplink ports take SFP and SFP+ transceivers. A Virtual Chassis can be formed with SFP+ and not with SFP
svg.data-virtual-chassis: up to four switches; the -VC part number ships with the Virtual Chassis licence on paper, the other part numbers do not
